name: cfg-memory-root-dir
about: memory.rootDir 改到 {HOME}/memroot（parseMemoryConfig.ts:71，缺省 <PilotHome>/memory），其余与 memory-enabled 相同（edgeclaw，不配模型）：memory_list / memory_wipe 的返回与落盘位置。另给 maxMessageChars、retrievalTimeoutMs、heartbeatBatchSize 与 schedule（reasoningMode、autoIndexIntervalMinutes=0、autoDreamIntervalMinutes=0）合法的非缺省值，看启动与这些方法不受影响、resolve_settings 的快照一致；它们的作用都要记忆模型参与，见报告。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
memory:
  enabled: true
  provider: edgeclaw
  captureStrategy: last_turn
  includeAssistant: false
  rootDir: {HOME}/memroot
  maxMessageChars: 500
  retrievalTimeoutMs: 1500
  heartbeatBatchSize: 3
  schedule:
    reasoningMode: accuracy_first
    autoIndexIntervalMinutes: 0
    autoDreamIntervalMinutes: 0
